meta.title: GitHub stars
meta.description: Star the GitHub repositories behind your installed plugins, right from the Plugins page.

intro: Every installed plugin with a GitHub home. A star is public: it shows on your GitHub profile and in your followers' feeds.
empty: No installed plugin declares a GitHub repository.
tokenHint: Required to star. Create a classic token with the `public_repo` scope, or a fine-grained token with read access to public repositories. Browsing works without one.
confirmBody: Starring shows on your GitHub profile and in your followers' feeds, under your own account name. You can unstar at any time by clicking again.
authNeeded: Add a GitHub token first — starring needs an account.
rateLimited: GitHub's anonymous rate limit is used up. Add a token, or try again after {0}.
demoNotice: Showing local plugins without a GitHub repository.
